hints.title: Selective Column Deduplication
hints.text: Multiple rows may share identical values in a specific attribute while differing across others. How can redundant records be removed based on a single chosen attribute while retaining initial occurrences?

hints.title: Subset Deduplication Method
hints.text: Pandas provides dedicated deduplication routines that allow specifying a subset of columns to evaluate, retaining the first occurrence by default.

hints.title: Targeted Column Deduplication
hints.text: Invoke drop_duplicates on the customers DataFrame, specifying subset=['email'] as an argument. Return the deduplicated DataFrame.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear scan with internal hash set evaluation over email column.
